name: Throat & swallowing

chart.yLabel: % of each sip reaching the stomach

overlay.caption: rings of muscle squeeze in a wave → food moves the right way, whichever way up you are

does: Shows swallowing working at any body angle because muscles do the pushing
Shows gravity helping a little when upright, so liquid arrives a bit sooner
Shows bigger gulps being slightly harder to manage upside down
doesnt: Measure any real person — the numbers are illustrative teaching values
Include choking, breathing, or how the airway is protected
Suggest anyone should practise drinking upside down
limits.text: This is a simplified learning model. Real people vary with age, fitness and health. The numbers are illustrative, not measurements of any real person.
limits.wellbeing: Eat and drink sitting up in everyday life; if swallowing ever hurts or feels stuck, tell an adult.

sources: CK-12 Life Science: digestive system, the esophagus
NASA: how astronauts eat and drink in space (student page)
